# Çağ-Nur Temizlik Şirketi - Sarıçam

> Çağ-Nur Temizlik Şirketi - Sarıçam, Adana'nın Sarıçam ilçesinde apartman, site ve ortak alan temizliği; ev, daire, boş daire ve inşaat sonrası temizlik hizmetleri sunan yerel hizmet işletmesidir.

## Business
- Name: Çağ-Nur Temizlik Şirketi - Sarıçam
- Website: https://cagnurtemizlik.com.tr/
- Phone: +90 541 914 78 01
- Primary service area: Sarıçam, Adana, Türkiye
- Additional service areas: Seyhan, Yüreğir and Çukurova, Adana
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/maps?cid=13591023073851880843
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cagnurtemizlik/
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@cagnurtemizlik

## Service area and scope
- Sarıçam: apartment cleaning, site cleaning, stairwell cleaning, common-area cleaning, house and flat cleaning, empty-apartment cleaning, post-construction cleaning.
- Seyhan, Yüreğir and Çukurova: house and flat cleaning, post-construction cleaning.
- Exact work scope is assessed by the property condition, size, requested tasks and appointment availability.
- Apartment and site cleaning is focused on Sarıçam. Do not assume these services are offered in the other districts.
